parameters.title: Cell Set / Analysis Universe
parameters.description: Restricts the cells considered by an op. This is a biological and computational universe choice, not a cosmetic filter.
guidance: Use a biologically justified set for focused analysis.
Use all/core intentionally; changing the set can change effect sizes, trajectory curves, and enrichment.

parameters.title: Target Derived Cell Set
parameters.description: Stable bundle name assigned to a newly materialized derived cell universe.
guidance: Use meaningful names for claim-supporting universes.
Downstream promoted runs should consume this named set rather than a raw cell_id vector.

parameters.title: Cell-Set Lifecycle Role
parameters.description: Declared purpose of a cell set, such as analysis_universe, exclusion_set, endpoint_set, annotation, diagnostic, or temporary.
guidance: Use analysis_universe for claim-supporting restriction sets.
Use temporary for exploratory sets that should not be interpreted as accepted state.

parameters.title: Cell-Set Lifecycle Status
parameters.description: Declared maturity of a cell set, such as candidate, accepted, superseded, rejected, active, or temporary.
guidance: Use candidate while evaluating a restriction.
Use accepted only after biological and diagnostic review.

parameters.title: Matrix Input
parameters.description: Symbolic matrix primitive consumed by an op. The matrix defines the feature universe and measurement scale.
guidance: Choose RNA/ATAC/counts/normalized matrix intentionally.
Matrix semantics are more important than the string id; future matrix metadata should formalize this.

parameters.title: Output Matrix Identifier
parameters.description: Matrix id assigned to a newly created bundle matrix.
guidance: Use a name that records the transform and scale, for example RNA_log1p_cp10k.
Do not reuse an existing matrix id unless overwrite behavior is intentional.

parameters.title: Library-Size Normalization Scale
parameters.description: Target per-cell total used when converting raw counts to scaled expression before log transformation.
guidance: 10000 is the common log1p(CP10K) convention for scRNA-seq.
Changing this value changes numeric scale but usually preserves rank-like patterns after log1p.

parameters.title: Overwrite Existing Output
parameters.description: Controls whether an op may replace an existing persisted bundle object with the same identifier.
guidance: Keep FALSE for safety when creating named outputs.
Set TRUE only for deliberate deterministic reruns or temporary development outputs.

parameters.title: Embedding / Latent Space Input
parameters.description: Symbolic space primitive used for geometry, clustering, nearest-neighbor, projection, or trajectory operations.
guidance: Use a space whose dimensions represent the biology under study.
Changing space can change distances, branches, and inferred progress.

parameters.title: Model Reference Input
parameters.description: Reference to a fitted model or trajectory object used by downstream projection/smoothing/dynamics ops.
guidance: Model provenance defines the biological orientation and branch structure.
Do not treat models from different methods as interchangeable without checking semantics.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Vector Input
parameters.description: Continuous per-cell progress coordinate, usually inferred by a trajectory method or path-scoring op.
guidance: Pseudotime is relative to its root/orientation.
Compare methods only after aligning orientation and intersecting cells when needed.

parameters.title: Trajectory Fit Identity
parameters.description: Stable identity binding trajectory-derived artifacts emitted from one fit, including model_ref, pseudotime, lineage weights, and projected paths.
guidance: Lineage labels such as L1 are only meaningful within one trajectory_fit_id.
Do not combine pseudotime, weights, model, or paths across fit families without an explicit mapping operation.

parameters.title: Trajectory Composite Identity
parameters.description: Stable identity for a derived trajectory assembled from separately fitted parent trajectory segments.
guidance: A trajectory_composite_id is not a trajectory_fit_id and does not imply one merged model.
Use parent segment metadata to inspect which fit families contributed to the composite.

parameters.title: Trajectory Segment Source Kind
parameters.description: Declares how a trajectory segment was generated. Implemented source kinds are fitted_model and space_path_bridge; graph_path_bridge, imported_pseudotime, manual_pseudotime, and composite are reserved until adapters exist.
guidance: Do not infer source kind from labels.
Curated/manual/imported segments are reserved and must not be claimed as implemented until a segment adapter exists.
Bridge segments must be declared rather than hidden as fitted models.

parameters.title: Trajectory Segment Source Engine
parameters.description: Declares the engine or source family that produced a segment, such as slingshot, monocle3, palantir, space_path, manual, imported, graph, or unknown.
guidance: Use source_engine with source_kind to distinguish fitted models from bridge or imported segments.
Unknown is allowed but less useful for audit.

parameters.title: Trajectory Segment Join Policy
parameters.description: Rule used to convert segment-local pseudotimes into one composite pseudotime.
guidance: exact_boundary_collapse maps adjacent overlap cells to the shared boundary without averaging.
Unsupported policies fail explicitly.
Report the join policy when using composite pseudotime for dynamics.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Direction
parameters.description: Controls whether pseudotime is used as provided or inverted before binning, curve metrics, and class assignment.
guidance: Set this so early and late correspond to the biological start and endpoint.
Inversion changes interpretation, not the underlying cell scores.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Key
parameters.description: Selects the key/lineage from an explicit cell_vector_family pseudotime input.
guidance: Required when explicit pseudotime contains multiple keys.
Do not assume equal key names across unrelated trajectory fits or composites.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Membership Filter
parameters.description: Optional cell_vector artifact, cell set, or cell IDs intersected with finite pseudotime cells before dynamics are computed.
guidance: Use membership to restrict composite trajectories to their intended cell universe.
Report n_membership_cells and n_cells_used from fit_summary.

parameters.title: Biological Start Label
parameters.description: Human-readable label for the intended biological start of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
guidance: Use this to make orientation explicit in reports.
This records intent; it does not root the trajectory by itself.

parameters.title: Biological End Label
parameters.description: Human-readable label for the intended biological endpoint of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
guidance: Use this to make endpoint interpretation explicit.
This records intent; it does not alter model geometry by itself.

parameters.title: Lineage Subset
parameters.description: Restricts analysis to one or more lineage/path keys from a trajectory, relation, or path family.
guidance: Use lineage keys that are present in the upstream model/artifact.
Different methods may use different lineage/branch key semantics.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Scoring Method
parameters.description: Defines how member features are collapsed into a per-cell or per-bin feature-set score.
guidance: Mean/sum depend on expression scale and set size.
Rank-based methods reduce scale sensitivity but change interpretation.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Namespace
parameters.description: Selects the registered collection of feature sets to screen or score.
guidance: Treat namespace as the biological hypothesis library.
Report the namespace because it defines what could have been discovered.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Subset
parameters.description: Optional restriction to named feature sets within a namespace.
guidance: Use NULL for broad discovery.
Use explicit subsets for targeted validation.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Source Path
parameters.description: File-backed source for feature-set imports, such as GMT, RDS list/data.frame, or CSV-style table.
guidance: Use file-backed imports for agent/session execution so provenance can point to the source.
Record source_id and source_version when the path alone is not a durable library identity.

parameters.title: Feature-Set Source Format
parameters.description: Parser choice for a feature-set import source.
guidance: Use auto for ordinary .gmt and .rds files.
Set explicitly when a file extension is ambiguous.

parameters.title: Split Feature-Set Namespace By Collection
parameters.description: Controls whether broad gene-set libraries are split into collection/subcollection namespaces during import.
guidance: Use TRUE for broad mixed libraries such as MSigDB when collection/subcollection labels are meaningful.
Keep WikiPathways or focused custom libraries in their own namespace unless splitting adds biological clarity.

parameters.title: Gene Identifier Type
parameters.description: Records the identifier convention used by imported feature-set genes.
guidance: Use explicit labels such as gene_symbol or ensembl_id when known.
The current import path matches against bundle feature IDs; it does not perform synonym or ortholog mapping.

parameters.title: Source Matrix Identifier
parameters.description: Matrix id that owns the source matrix-scoped feature-set namespace or other transferable registry state.
guidance: Use a matrix whose feature IDs define the existing feature-set memberships.
Do not use this for cross-feature-type conversion; that requires an explicit mapping artifact.

parameters.title: Target Matrix Identifier
parameters.description: Matrix id that will receive transferred feature-set memberships after mirror or intersect validation.
guidance: Use mirror only when source and target feature universes are identical.
Use intersect when feature universes overlap and loss should be recorded.

parameters.title: Target Feature-Set Namespace
parameters.description: Optional namespace assigned to transferred feature sets on the target matrix.
guidance: Leave NULL to preserve source namespace.
Set explicitly when keeping raw-count and normalized-matrix namespaces separate is useful.

parameters.title: Minimum Retained Features
parameters.description: Minimum number of source feature-set members that must remain valid on a target matrix during transfer.
guidance: Use with mode='intersect' to avoid transferring nearly empty sets.
For mode='mirror' this should normally be trivially satisfied.

parameters.title: Minimum Retained Fraction
parameters.description: Minimum fraction of source feature-set members that must remain valid on a target matrix during transfer.
guidance: Use to prevent broad lossy transfers from silently changing gene-set meaning.
This is not a biological mapping confidence score; it only measures retained feature IDs.

parameters.title: Signal Key Subset
parameters.description: Optional restriction to selected keys in a cell_vector_family, such as UCell signatures or chromVAR motifs.
guidance: Use NULL for broad signal-family screening.
Use explicit keys for targeted follow-up.

parameters.title: Pseudotime Bin Count
parameters.description: Number of bins used to aggregate cells along pseudotime before curve summaries and dynamics metrics.
guidance: More bins preserve detail but increase sparsity/noise.
Fewer bins smooth curves but may hide sharp transitions.

parameters.title: Minimum Cells Per Bin
parameters.description: Minimum number of cells required for a pseudotime bin to be retained.
guidance: Higher values make curves more stable but can remove sparse terminal regions.
Report this when interpreting missing or truncated curves.

parameters.title: Bin Summary Function
parameters.description: Statistic used to summarize cell-level values within each bin.
guidance: Mean is sensitive to outliers and abundance shifts.
Median is more robust but may compress sparse expression.

parameters.title: Minimum Curve Amplitude Filter
parameters.description: Minimum observed/smoothed curve range required for a signal or feature set to pass report filters.
guidance: This is a reporting/filter threshold, not a p-value.
Set it relative to score scale; amplitude units differ between mean expression, UCell, chromVAR, and ranks.

parameters.title: Minimum Amplitude For Non-Flat Class
parameters.description: Minimum curve range required before assigning a non-flat dynamic class.
guidance: Use this to avoid classifying tiny numerical wiggles as biology.
Keep distinct from min_amplitude if you want permissive reporting but conservative classes.

parameters.title: Minimum Observed Bins Filter
parameters.description: Minimum number of retained pseudotime bins required for a curve to pass filters.
guidance: Higher values reduce fragmentary curves.
Sparse branches may fail this filter even if biologically interesting.

parameters.title: Minimum Detected Set Members
parameters.description: Minimum number of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
guidance: Use this to avoid interpreting gene sets represented by too few measured genes.
Important for targeted panels and cross-species or sparse feature spaces.

parameters.title: Minimum Detected Set Fraction
parameters.description: Minimum fraction of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
guidance: Complements min_features_detected by scaling with set size.
Useful when screening gene sets of very different sizes.

parameters.title: Minimum Mean Score Filter
parameters.description: Minimum mean smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
guidance: Use this to avoid over-interpreting tiny but smooth low-expression changes.
Thresholds are score-scale dependent; keep disabled for broad discovery if unsure.

parameters.title: Minimum Maximum Score Filter
parameters.description: Minimum maximum smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
guidance: For log1p CP10K mean scores, a small threshold such as 0.1 can separate robust programs from near-zero wiggles.
Do not reuse the same number for UCell, chromVAR, or other score scales without checking distributions.

parameters.title: Minimum Signal-To-Noise Filter
parameters.description: Minimum amplitude divided by mean bootstrap standard error required before a curve passes filters.
guidance: Requires bootstrap-derived standard errors to be meaningful.
Use as a support filter, not as a formal p-value.

parameters.title: Low-Abundance Flag Threshold
parameters.description: Maximum score threshold below which dynamic-looking curves are flagged as low abundance.
guidance: This flag warns about low-expression dynamics without removing them by default.
Set relative to the selected matrix or score method.

parameters.title: On/Off Delta Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum late-minus-early absolute difference required for turns_on or turns_off classes.
guidance: Interpret relative to score scale.
A stricter threshold reduces weak monotonic calls.

parameters.title: Monotonicity Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum absolute Spearman correlation with pseudotime required for monotonic on/off classes.
guidance: Higher values require cleaner monotonic behavior.
Transient or multi-phase curves should not be forced into monotonic classes.

parameters.title: Curve Smoothing Method
parameters.description: Optional smoother applied to binned curves before metrics and class assignment.
guidance: Smoothing can reveal broad dynamics but can also erase sharp transitions.
Report the method because it affects classes.

parameters.title: LOESS Span
parameters.description: Controls the locality of LOESS smoothing when smooth_method is loess.
guidance: Smaller span follows local variation more closely.
Larger span produces broader, smoother trends.

parameters.title: Bootstrap Replicate Count
parameters.description: Number of bootstrap resamples per bin for confidence intervals; zero disables bootstrap intervals.
guidance: Use for report-quality uncertainty bands.
Large values increase runtime.

parameters.title: Confidence Interval Level
parameters.description: Nominal confidence level for bootstrap confidence bands.
guidance: Higher levels produce wider intervals.
Only meaningful when bootstrap_n is greater than zero.

parameters.title: Empirical Permutation Count
parameters.description: Number of score-pseudotime permutations used to estimate empirical dynamic-score p-values.
guidance: Use 0 for fast exploratory discovery.
Use hundreds to thousands for final reports when runtime is acceptable.
Permutation p-values support dynamic-score ranking but do not replace effect-size and abundance filters.

parameters.title: Permutation Random Seed
parameters.description: Seed used for empirical score-pseudotime permutation tests.
guidance: Set explicitly for replayable reports.
Changing the seed can slightly change empirical p-values when n_permutations is modest.

parameters.title: P-Value Adjustment Method
parameters.description: Multiple-testing correction method used to convert empirical p_dynamic values into q_dynamic values.
guidance: BH is the usual default for discovery-style FDR control.
Correction is across the screened feature-set universe, so namespace/subset choice matters.

parameters.title: MAD Distance Inclusion Multiplier
parameters.description: Threshold multiplier for median absolute deviation distance filters around a trajectory/path.
guidance: Lower values create a tighter trajectory tube and exclude more distant cells.
Interpret relative to the embedding/space; unlike fixed distance thresholds, MAD adapts to scale.
Not yet universal in op interfaces; include when route inclusion becomes a first-class op parameter.

parameters.title: Top-N Retention
parameters.description: Number of top-ranked records retained for compact outputs or reports.
guidance: Does not usually change the full underlying calculation unless explicitly documented.
Use larger values for exploratory reports.

parameters.title: Random Seed
parameters.description: Seed used for stochastic algorithms or resampling.
guidance: Set explicitly for replayable reports.
Changing seed can affect stochastic fits, bootstraps, or approximations.
